parties.petitioner: M/s Shri Sendhur Agro & Oil Industries

summary: Transfer of criminal proceedings under Section 138 N.I. Act sought from Chandigarh to Coimbatore; entire transaction occurred in Tamil Nadu; loan processing, account operation, collateral, and ECS transactions based in Coimbatore; complaint filed in Chandigarh allegedly for harassment; jurisdiction challenged under Section 142; bank required to explain filing in Chandigarh; stay granted on proceedings; ends of justice warrant transfer; proceedings initiated despite SARFAESI recovery and sale in Coimbatore; allegations of procedural abuse and forum shopping.
final_judgment: Transfer petitions allowed; complaint proceedings in Chandigarh stayed; matter to be transferred to competent court in Coimbatore for disposal in accordance with law.
